_signals.x_guidance: DeepBlue is a live x402/MPP-payable crypto-trading signals API. GET /signals returns Polymarket 5-min BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP UP/DOWN signals with confidence (~$0.012/call, sub-1c). GET /btc-price, /eth-price, /sol-price, /xrp-price return Chainlink Data Streams prices ($0.001 each). GET /trending and /discover surface ecosystem-wide trending tokens. GET /market-snapshot is a BTC macro bundle. All endpoints settle in USDC on Base; no API keys, no auth, just pay-and-call.
